subject: general
question: Pranav borrows a sum of ₹598397at the rate of 20% per annum simple interest. At the end of the first year, he repays ₹24284 towards return of principal amount borrowed. If Pranav clears all pending dues at the end of the second year, including interest payment that accrued during the first year, how much does he pay (in ₹) at the end of the second year?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Final payment = Total amount of initial loan − Equivalent amount of partial repayment

Total Due = P × (1 + 2R) − Repayment × (1 + R)

⇒ Total Due = 598397 × (1 + 0.40) − 24284 × (1 + 0.20)

⇒ Total Due = 598397 × 1.4 − 24284 × 1.2

⇒ Total Due = 837755.8 − 29140.8 = 808615

**∴ The correct answer is ₹808615.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20a7861a7f6276ce29f85bc93844f37180cbcff9e824f67a5cb127ce4dfd8268.png] 

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹598397, Rate (R) = 20% per annum

Repayment of Principal at end of 1st year = ₹24284

**Calculations:**

⇒ Outstanding principal for 2nd year = 598397 − 24284 = ₹574113

⇒ Interest for 1st year = 20% of 598397 = ₹119679.4

⇒ Interest for 2nd year = 20% of 574113 = ₹114822.6

⇒ Total Interest = 119679.4 + 114822.6 = ₹234502

⇒ Total Amount to pay = Pending Principal + Total Interest

⇒ Total Amount = 574113 + 234502 = ₹808615

**∴ The correct answer is ₹808615.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

In Simple Interest, interest is calculated only on the remaining principal, meaning accumulated past interest does not earn further interest.

Simple Interest Formula

The interest accumulated over time is given directly by the formula I = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Equivalent Amount Method

For simple interest partial payments, the total outstanding balance can be easily determined by evaluating the final amount of the initial principal and subtracting the respective equivalent amounts of each partial repayment up to the end term.
